text:
alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we breached p95 latency SLO during last night's spike. Proposing an SLO reset + a small playbook for the recurring cache-warmup regressions. Assigning owners/timelines in-thread. /cc @maya @devon

maya: Seen the graphs — p95 jumped ~220ms -> 1.6s for a ~30m window. Error budget burned ~8% for prod. Dashboard: https://redwood/internal/dashboards/slo-latency (private)

devon: I can own runbook updates + dashboard tiles. Plan: runbook draft by EOD Tue, alert PR + dashboard changes Wed morning.

alex: Assigned runbook/dashboard to devon. @kate can you own customer/SLA comms for Dedicated customers? Need to confirm if any SLA adjustments required.

kate: Yep. Will draft a short customer note and sync with sales/legal. Target Wed COB to share a draft in #customer-success.

sre-bot: Incident logged: INCIDENT-2026-410000. Pager duty notified.

sam: Pattern note — cold KV cache misses strongly correlate with deploys to pool-b. Recommend an auto-prefill (warmup) job post-deploy. I can prototype.

devon: Prototype plan sounds good. Timeline: prefiller prototype + staging load test by Fri. If results look stable, canary rollout next week.

alex: Action list (summary): devon -> runbook & dashboard (EOD Tue), sam -> prefiller prototype (Fri), kate -> SLA/customer note (Wed), maya -> add perf regression eval prompts (Thu). I'll schedule a follow-up sync Thu 10:30am.

maya: Also proposing alert tuning: new p95 alert at 700ms (5m eval window) and paging if sustained >3m. I'll open an alert PR and include paging thresholds.

devon: Adding playbook steps to the PR: `check kvcache fill-rate`, `restart pool-b nodes`, `rollback canary`. Will link runbook sections.

alex: Good. Once alert PR is merged I'll do an error-budget window reset per the new runbook rules so dashboards reflect the adjusted baseline. :thumbsup:

kate: Note for comms: only notify Dedicated customers if projected SLA impact > 1% for a billing period. I'll coordinate with legal on wording.

alex: Thanks all — I'll post minutes+owners in #postmortems after this. If anyone wants to add more items, drop them here and I'll fold into the runbook.
